settings.title: Time & data
settings.fixed: Fixed time (UTC; the clock runs on from there)
settings.policy: Time policy (which element sets to use at that time)
settings.badTime: The time is not in a valid format
settings.persisted: Settings are saved and survive a restart (except the time).
settings.notPersisted: Settings apply to this run only.
policy.known-at: Data already fetched at that time
policy.nearest-epoch: Data with the epoch closest to that time
collect.daemon: Collected by a resident collector (orbitscope collect)
collect.external: Collected by a scheduled system task (orbitscope fetch)
collectHint.serve: This web server checks the data sources and collects once an hour (still subject to each source's minimum interval).
collectHint.daemon: This web server stays offline and only reads local history; run orbitscope collect separately as a resident process (see the autostart files in deploy/).
collectHint.external: This web server stays offline and only reads local history; a scheduled system task must run orbitscope fetch (see the examples in deploy/).
prov.nearest-epoch: data with the epoch closest to {time}
prov.latest: the newest data in the history
prov.disabled: History archive is off: showing the sources' latest data.
prov.waiting: No data basis yet (waiting for the first load).
prov.empty: Data basis: {what} — no data (this time may be earlier than the first collection).
prov.full: Data basis: {what}; {count} element sets selected, fetched between {from} and {to} (UTC).
filter.title: Filters
filter.unknownInclude: Include objects whose size cannot be determined
filter.err.altOrder: Min altitude cannot be greater than max altitude
filter.err.age: Element age must be a non-negative number

stats.title: Statistics
sources.title: Data sources
sources.passive: This server does not collect online; data comes from local history (see the collection log below).
